# Gilbert Blythe

- **Gender:** male  <sub>[v1 c15 P28](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0028)</sub>

- **Origin:** Avonlea  <sub>[v1 c15 P16](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0016), [v1 c31 P10](../source/v01-c31.md#nw-v01-c31-p0010)</sub>
- **Role:** college student and former teacher  <sub>[v2 c7 P8](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0008), [v3 c5 P0](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0000), [v3 c37 P31](../source/v03-c37.md#nw-v03-c37-p0031)</sub>

- **Nicknames:** Gil  <sub>[v1 c15 P24](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0024), [v1 c18 P10](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0010), [v1 c25 P55](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0055)</sub>

## Appearance

Gilbert is a tall, handsome boy with curly brown hair, roguish hazel eyes, and a mouth often twisted into a teasing smile. As he matures into a young man, he becomes broad-shouldered, frank-faced, and manly in appearance. Following an intense period of studying and a severe bout of typhoid fever, he is noted to look quite thin and pale.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P16](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0016), [v1 c15 P28](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0028), [v2 c19 P50](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0050), [v3 c29 P12](../source/v03-c29.md#nw-v03-c29-p0012), [v3 c39 P22](../source/v03-c39.md#nw-v03-c39-p0022)_

## Personality

Gilbert is clever, ambitious, and studious, holding a deep determination to succeed in his studies and pursue his goals. He has a lively sense of humor and a fond inclination toward teasing and practical jokes, yet he possesses a deeply thoughtful, good-natured, and self-sacrificing disposition. In his personal relationships, he is steadfast, gracious, and courteous even when faced with disappointment.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P16](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0016), [v1 c15 P28](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0028), [v1 c17 P36](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0036), [v1 c35 P3](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0003), [v1 c38 P38](../source/v01-c38.md#nw-v01-c38-p0038), [v3 c25 P25](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0025), [v3 c27 P36](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0036)_

## History

After spending three years in Alberta with his sick father, Gilbert returned to Avonlea to resume his schooling. He quickly established a fierce academic rivalry with Anne Shirley that lasted through their school years and their time at Queen's Academy, where he won the medal in their graduating class. Although he originally applied for the Avonlea school teaching post, he surrendered it to Anne so she could stay near Green Gables, taking a position at White Sands instead to save money for college. During his time teaching, he co-founded the Avonlea Village Improvement Society and served as its president. He later attended Redmond College alongside Anne, leading the Freshmen to victory in the Arts Rush, becoming class president, and captaining the football team. Gilbert proposed to Anne in their second year at Redmond, but she refused him, leading to a period of distant courtesy between them. Following his graduation with High Honors and the Cooper Prize, he suffered a near-fatal attack of typhoid fever. Upon receiving word via Phil Gordon that Anne did not care for Roy Gardner, he recovered quickly and proposed to Anne a second time, which she joyfully accepted.

## Background by volume

- spent three years in Alberta caring for his sick father  <sub>[v1 c15 P24](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0024)</sub>
- visited cousins in New Brunswick before returning to Avonlea school  <sub>[v1 c15 P16](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0016)</sub>
